title: Scheduled reports
subtitle: Automatically collect news and web analytics for your topics, brand, competitors, and website.
name: Schedule name
queriesPlaceholder:
Brand name
Industry news
Competitor products
queriesHelp: Enter one query per line. A separate analytics report is created for each query, using the same brand, competitors, website, and filters.
invalidQueries: Each query must contain 2 to 180 characters.
queryRouting: Use plain text queries without SearXNG engine or language commands (! or :).
invalidNames: Brand and competitor names cannot contain control characters.
periodHelp: Reports run at the selected time every 1, 3, or 7 days, or on the first of each month.
dataHelp: Frequency and search period are separate settings. Each run saves the current search sample. The period filter depends on search engines and is not a complete archive of publications.
websiteHelp: Reports remain available on the website whether Telegram delivery is enabled or not.
botHelp: Link your Telegram account and enable automatic file delivery in bot settings to receive reports.
botExportsHelp: Enable automatic file delivery in bot settings. Until then, reports are saved on the website.
created: Schedule created. Reports will appear after the first run.
queued: Report generation queued. The results will appear in history.
error: Unable to load or update reports. Please try again.
optionsError: Unable to load search filters. Close this form and select Refresh to try again.
limitReached: The schedule limit has been reached. Delete a schedule to add another.
emptySchedules: Create a schedule to collect news and analytics automatically.
confirmDelete: Delete this schedule? Automatic generation will stop. Saved reports will remain available.
emptyHistory: No reports yet. Wait for the scheduled run or select Generate now.
reportFailed: This report could not be generated. Try again when search is available.
